official.deadline_note: The call page states applications close impreterivelmente at 16h (Brasilia time) on 23 October 2026, with no extension for any reason.
official.application_cycle: Edital CG Fiocruz no 02/2026, for overseas activities beginning September and October 2027
official.status_note: Edital aberto since 15 September 2026 (10:00); proposals are accepted exclusively through the electronic form until 16:00 Brasilia time on 23 October 2026. Results and appeals are published exclusively on the call page.
benefits: Short-term training placement abroad: treinamentos, cursos tecnicos, cientificos or pedagogicos - language training (capacitacao linguistica) is expressly excluded
Start of overseas activities in September and October 2027
Individual skills development and institutional strengthening of graduate programmes in the CAPES Global network
eligibility: Docentes, pesquisadores e tecnicos with a formal (CLT or statutory) employment relationship with Fundacao Oswaldo Cruz, involved in activities linked to a Fiocruz graduate programme in the CAPES Global network
OR master's or doctoral students duly registered on the CAPES Sucupira platform as students of a Fiocruz graduate programme linked to the network's strategic themes
The candidate's graduate programme must be linked to the strategic themes of the Rede CAPES Global para o Desenvolvimento Sustentavel, Ciencia e Saude (Annex I)
Each candidate linked to Fiocruz may register in only ONE of the five editais offered by the Comite Gestor; registering in more than one voids all registrations automatically
Candidates already in selection under earlier editais are considered under a single candidature - only the first submission is valid and the rest are annulled
requirements: Submit the proposal exclusively through the electronic application form on the call page
First-time users of the Fiocruz site must register beforehand using the link on the application page
Choose a single modality among the five Fiocruz editais
Submitting the proposal presumes knowledge and acceptance of the edital's conditions, of which no later ignorance may be claimed
documents: Anexo II - Plano de Atividade Capacitacao
Anexo III - Qualificacao de parceria internacional
Anexo VII - Carta de aceite da instituicao de ensino superior no exterior
Anexo V (discente) or Anexo VI (profissionais) - cartas de apoio do orientador / do PPG e da chefia
Anexo VIII (profissionais) and Anexo IX (orientador do discente) - declaracoes de fluencia linguistica
Anexo X - autodeclaracao de equidade (Anexo XI covers appeals)
coverage: Short-term technical, scientific or pedagogical training abroad for Fiocruz staff, researchers and postgraduates
Strengthening of the human resources of the participating graduate programmes; language training excluded
application_method: Online application form on the Fiocruz Campus Virtual editais platform
Questions to rede.capesglobal@fiocruz.br (subject: Edital CG Fiocruz 02/2026 - Capacitacao)
official.application_route: Submit the proposal exclusively through the electronic application form published on the Fiocruz Campus Virtual call page between 15 September and 23 October 2026 (16:00 Brasilia time).
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Candidates must be linked to a Fiocruz graduate programme belonging to the CAPES Global network's strategic themes listed in Annex I
official.description: The Fiocruz Managing Committee's call for Capacitacao de curta duracao no Exterior scholarships under the CAPES-Global.Edu programme (CAPES Edital no 13/2025), aimed at individual development and institutional strengthening through technical, scientific or pedagogical training abroad, expressly excluding language training, with overseas activities starting September and October 2027.
official.program_type: Research-institute short-term training abroad scholarship administered under the CAPES-Global.Edu programme
official.english_requirement: A language-fluency declaration is among the call annexes (Anexo VIII for professionals; Anexo IX for the student's supervisor); no language test or score is published

not_confirmed: funding_amount / funding_currency / funding_period - no financial values are published on the call page; the financial terms sit in CAPES Edital no 13/2025 and are not reproduced
tuition_coverage / living_cost_coverage / travel_coverage - not stated on the call page
duration - not stated; only the September-October 2027 start of overseas activities is published
selection criteria and weighting - the call page publishes none
verification.notes: The Fiocruz Campus Virtual call page was read in full on 2026-10-10, including the annex list; the application deadline (23 October 2026, 16:00 Brasilia time), the single-edital rule and the start of overseas activities (September-October 2027) were confirmed on that page. No monetary figures appear anywhere on it, so all funding fields are null by design.

applicant_utility.summary: This call funds a short technical, scientific or pedagogical training stint abroad for people formally tied to Fiocruz, with overseas activity starting September or October 2027 - and language courses are explicitly excluded. The hard filter is administrative: you may register in only one of the five Comite Gestor editais, and a duplicate registration voids all of them automatically. Nothing on the page states a stipend value, so treat the financial side as whatever CAPES Edital 13/2025 sets and verify it with the programme before budgeting.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Fiocruz staff with a formal CLT or statutory contract, and Fiocruz master's or doctoral students on Sucupira, whose graduate programme sits in the CAPES Global strategic themes and who need a short training period at a foreign institution.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your graduate programme appears in Annex I (temas estrategicos) before drafting anything
Decide which single one of the five Comite Gestor editais you will enter - a second registration cancels all of them
If you are entering an earlier Fiocruz edital too, submit this one first, since only the first submission stays valid
Secure the foreign host institution's acceptance letter (Anexo VII) early - it is the long-lead document
Line up the supporting letters (orientador; PPG and chefia) that match your profile (discente vs profissional)
Register on the Fiocruz site in advance if this is your first access, so login issues cannot eat the deadline
common_rejection_risks: Registering in more than one of the five editais - an automatic, exception-free annulment
Applying with a programme that is not linked to the CAPES Global strategic themes in Annex I
Proposing a language course, which the modality expressly excludes
Submitting outside the electronic form or after 16:00 Brasilia time on 23 October 2026 - no extension is promised
Being mid-selection in an earlier edital and assuming both candidacies survive - only the first does
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Not published on the call page; the page reproduces no stipend, travel or tuition figures, so assume the CAPES Edital 13/2025 rules govern what is and is not paid and confirm with rede.capesglobal@fiocruz.br before committing.
document_audit: The annex set differs by profile: discentes use Anexo V and the supervisor's fluency declaration (Anexo IX), while profissionais use Anexo VI and their own (Anexo VIII)
The host institution's acceptance letter (Anexo VII) must come from a higher-education institution abroad, not a course provider's informal email
Anexo X (equity self-declaration) and Anexo XI (appeal form) are separate files - do not assume the form bundles them
alerts: Applications close at 16:00 Brasilia time on 23 October 2026 and the page warns there will be no prorogation - do not leave submission to the final hour
Overseas activities only start in September or October 2027, roughly a year after the deadline - plan work and leave around that window
All results and appeals appear exclusively on the call page; nothing is sent individually, so monitor the page
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: One electronic form on the Fiocruz Campus Virtual platform; the proposal is valid only if submitted there within the window, and every result or appeal is then published on the same page.
